headline: The shell, picker and soak screens hold up, and CI's emulator is 7/7. The OTP/TAC filter still fails both ways: six ordinary OTP shapes are stored (a Blocker under the non-negotiable), and five shapes of real payment are silently dropped.

findings.title: The OTP/TAC filter stores OTPs and TACs in six ordinary shapes, so they reach the outbox
findings.detail: A notification is dropped only when it has a keyword **and** a code that `OtpFilter.isCode` accepts: 6–8 contiguous digits, or 4–5 straight after the keyword. Codes split by a space or hyphen (`123 456`, `123-456`) never match `NUMBER`. A code after `#` or `-` is refused by `GLUED_BEFORE` (`G-482910`, `TAC is #482910`). A code after `No.` is refused by `NOT_A_CODE_BEFORE` (`TAC No. 482910`). A 4-digit code with words between it and the keyword is ignored (`Your OTP for login: 4829`). Each of these from a chosen app is stored raw in the outbox. That breaks the CLAUDE.md non-negotiable: the listener discards OTP/TAC messages in native code before anything is stored. Android 15+ hiding OTPs from listeners is the first line; this filter is the second (§6.2), and it has to hold on its own.

findings.title: Real payments are silently dropped as OTPs when a security footer meets any 6–8 digit number
findings.detail: The phrases `never share`, `do not share`, `jangan kongsi` and `pin` are keywords, and any unprefixed 6–8 digit number counts as a code anywhere in the text. A bank's standard footer plus a store number, merchant id, approval code, `No. Transaksi …` or `Reference number …` (or a payee named PIN) therefore drops a genuine payment. It leaves no row and no trace, so neither the soak nor Review can show it was missed. D115's fix covers `Ref`, `No`, `ID` and `acc` only when they sit right before the number. The fix could look like this: require the code within a short distance of an OTP keyword, and stop footer phrases counting as keywords on their own.

findings.title: The gate's tests don't pin chosen-first order or an exact package match (two probes stayed green)
findings.detail: `CaptureGateTest` says *even an OTP from it is NOT_CHOSEN: its text is never read*, but it posts `OTP 1`, which the filter doesn't treat as an OTP, so the order of the checks is never tested. Moving the chosen-apps check after the OTP check (P6) left 25/25 green. So did matching chosen packages by prefix (`my.rytbank.app.fake` accepted, P4). The real chosen-first check in `Capture.post` runs only on the emulator, where nothing asserts that extras aren't read.
findings.repro: In CaptureGate.kt move `if (p.packageName !in chosen) …` below the OTP line, then `gradle -p apps/shell/core test`; restore with git checkout
findings.evidence:

findings.title: The simulator's *Post it again* and *Post an OTP* only show a toast; they exercise no dedupe and no filter
findings.detail: `sim.repost()` and `sim.otp()` (apps/web/src/dev/capture-sim.ts) call `toastDone('Simulated: … not stored twice')` and `toastDone('Simulated: an OTP, dropped…')` without posting anything. FLOW-5 step 3 and FLOW-6 step 1 therefore pass whatever the code does: a browser walk of those sad paths proves nothing. The real behaviour is covered only by the Kotlin core and the CI emulator. This is run 1's finding 8, fixed in words rather than in behaviour.
findings.repro: Dev panel → Post an OTP: the outbox count can't change, because nothing is posted
findings.evidence: FLOW-6 step 1 passed: '0 notifications' before and after 'Post an OTP' (the sim never calls store())
findings.spec: AC-17, AC-21, CLAUDE.md (native-only features get a simulator)

findings.title: Keep Sen running promises a Home warning that doesn't exist until B07
findings.detail: On a brand with no steps, and in the not-tried line, the screen says *if capture stops, Sen warns you on Home*. The watchdog and Home's warning come in B07; during the soak nothing warns. Similarly, *If Sen's switch is greyed out* shows whenever access is off on Android 13+, because `restrictedSettings` is `SDK_INT >= 33` rather than a detected state. That's acceptable as guidance.
findings.repro: Dev panel → A brand with no steps → Settings → Capture → Keep Sen running
findings.evidence: 'Sen has no extra steps for Fairphone phones. The battery step above is usually enough; if capture stops, Sen warns you on Home.'

findings.title: No journey in docs/flows.md is marked core
findings.detail: The QA rules walk the *core* journeys every run. `docs/flows.md` marks none (no match for `core`). This run walked the parts of `first-run`, `capture-off` and `offline` that B02 touches. Open question for the owner or S2: which journeys are core.
